transcript:
Ana: Let's start. First up, the checkout regression — we're shipping the fix this sprint, P0.
Ben: Agreed. I'll own the patch and have a PR up by Wednesday.
Cara: I can review it Thursday morning.
Dev: We should also bump the SDK to 4.2 while we're in there.
Ana: Fine, but only if it doesn't widen the blast radius. Ben, scope it first.
Ben: Will do — I'll post a scoping note in the channel before Wednesday.
Cara: On the data side, we still can't run the migration. Legal hasn't signed off on the new schema.
Ana: That's blocking the analytics rollout entirely. Cara, can you escalate to Maya in legal today?
Cara: Yes, I'll email her right after this and CC you.
Dev: For the mobile crash on Android 14 — we're going with the workaround for now and the proper fix lands in Sprint 43.
Ana: Confirmed, workaround ships this sprint, proper fix Sprint 43. Dev owns both.
Dev: Got it. Workaround PR is already up, I'll merge after Ben's review.
Ben: I'll review the workaround today.
Cara: Quick one — the new pricing experiment. Do we launch on Monday?
Ana: Yes, launching Monday with the 5 percent cohort. Dev, can you confirm the flag is wired?
Dev: Confirmed, flag is in production behind the experiment gate.
Ana: Decision: pricing experiment launches Monday 2026-05-18 at 5 percent.
Ben: For the vendor onboarding flow — we're still waiting on the Acme API contract. That's stuck on their side.
Ana: How long?
Ben: They said two weeks, so end of May at the earliest. It's blocking the partner pilot.
Ana: Mark it high severity. Let's revisit in next week's sync.
Cara: I'd like to discuss the staffing for Q3 in a separate session — it's too big for today.
Ana: Agreed, let's schedule a Q3 staffing review. Cara, you set it up for after May 20?
Cara: Yes, I'll send invites tomorrow for a 60-min session next week.
Dev: One more — should we deprecate the v1 webhook endpoint? It's not urgent.
Ana: Let's punt that to async. Open a thread in #platform and we can decide there.
Dev: Will do, I'll post the thread this afternoon.
Ana: Last item — the on-call rotation for June. Ben, you're up for week 1, Cara week 2, Dev week 3, me week 4.
Ana: That's it. Thanks everyone.
